message:
test(update): read the log off disk rather than trusting the message

The failure strings were already checked for the credential. That is the
mechanism, not the file: "this message does not quote it" and "the file on
disk does not contain it" are different statements, and only the second one
is about a log.

So both processes now write a log the way updater_main writes one --
timestamped, built from the same error strings -- and the test reads it
back. Clean on the success path and on the failure path, while still saying
what happened: the worker's log records "credential received" and not what
was received.

Still the helper's log and not a real updater.log, for the same reason as
before: producing one means running the real updater, which copies itself
into an administrators-only directory and stops product processes.

Also recorded: adding the read deadline made the waits wrap-safe as a side
effect. remaining() is an unsigned subtraction, where the old
GetTickCount() > deadline comparison would have broken at 49.7 days -- a
lesson this repository already learned in update_handoff.cpp and needed
again in a different file.
